content: ComPsych, established in 1984, is recognized as the largest global provider of Employee Assistance Programs (EAPs). It specializes in delivering fully integrated services that encompass EAP, behavioral health, work-life balance, wellness, and HR and FMLA administration under its GuidanceResources® brand. The company operates in the United States and over 100 countries worldwide, serving a diverse clientele that includes Fortune 500 companies, smaller public and private organizations, government entities, and Taft-Hartley groups. ComPsych designs customized Build-to-Suit programs aimed at helping employers attract and retain talent while enhancing employee productivity and performance. The company is driven by a commitment to exceeding expectations, maintaining high-quality standards, and fostering innovation. Its services are continuously adapted to meet the evolving needs of businesses and employees, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and challenges. The company was founded by Dr. Richard A. Chaifetz, who serves as Chairman and CEO. ComPsych's focus on its core competencies and dedication to delivering top-tier services has resulted in consistent growth, financial stability, and long-term partnerships with its clients. Organizations that choose GuidanceResources benefit from staying ahead of business challenges and providing employees with timely, effective support. ComPsych Products and Services GuidanceResources® offers a comprehensive range of services, including EAP, work-life balance, behavioral health, and wellness programs. These services are designed to improve individuals' behavioral and physical health while addressing personal, family, and life issues. The programs foster high-performance workplace cultures, enabling organizations to attract and retain top talent, leading to superior productivity and profitability. ComPsych provides support for a wide array of personal concerns, such as emotional challenges, family and relationship issues, legal and financial matters, and wellness concerns. A team of professionals, including behavioral specialists, work-life experts, attorneys, financial advisors, wellness professionals, and concierges, is available 24/7 via phone, online, or in person. The programs are tailored to meet the unique needs of each organization, offering flexibility and customization. Behavioral Health Programs focus on managing costs without compromising care quality. These programs deliver significant cost savings while improving clinical outcomes and client satisfaction. Services include 24-hour pre-certification, claims administration, utilization management, and comprehensive reporting. The programs ensure individuals receive necessary care while organizations benefit from cost savings. Disability AssistSM addresses the mental health and work-life issues often associated with disability claims, such as depression, family challenges, and lifestyle adjustments. The program offers two models: Disability Assist-Outreach and Disability Assist-Management. These services include proactive outreach, tailored responses, case management, and education for HR and managers on mental health issues. The goal is to facilitate faster returns to work and reduce disability claim costs. Work-Life Services through FamilySource® provide expert consultation and referrals for child care, elder care, education, pet care, and concierge services. The program offers unlimited access to guidance, personalized information, and extensive online resources to address work-life needs effectively. LegalConnect® offers immediate, confidential access to licensed attorneys for legal issues such as divorce, estate planning, lawsuits, and bankruptcy. Services include telephonic and online consultations, referrals to local lawyers at discounted rates, and access to a comprehensive legal resource database. FinancialConnect® provides access to financial experts for issues like budgeting, credit problems, tax questions, and retirement planning. The program includes unlimited access to financial advice, online tools, and educational resources to help individuals address financial concerns effectively. ElderOutreach® supports individuals dealing with elder-care issues, such as adult care, illness, and financial planning. The program offers unlimited access to elder-care specialists, in-home assessments, and legal and financial expertise to alleviate stress and improve workplace productivity. HealthyGuidance® is a holistic wellness program targeting lifestyle and behavioral issues before they escalate into significant health problems. It includes health risk assessments, wellness coaching, and seminars to empower employees to make healthy lifestyle changes. Online Services GuidanceResources® Online is an interactive platform providing instant access to guidance, information, and tools for addressing life issues. The service integrates seamlessly with ComPsych's offline offerings, featuring expert-reviewed articles, self-assessment tools, and personalized content recommendations. HR Services FMLASource® offers expert administration and consultation on Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) compliance. The program provides outsourced administration, manager training, and online tracking of FMLA requests to reduce costs and compliance risks. HRConsultSM delivers expert consultation on organizational issues, including employee retention, regulatory compliance, workplace violence, and crisis intervention. The service offers training, seminars, and workshops to help organizations manage challenges effectively. Critical Incident Services Crisis Intervention WorldwideSM provides global support for managing traumatic events, such as violence, fatalities, natural disasters, and terrorist attacks. The service includes 24/7 access to crisis specialists, preventive planning, and post-event management to help organizations navigate crises effectively.
